name: dev-tasks
description: STEP Network dev-tasks plugin: Monday-driven task-first development for products on GitHub + Node/TS + pnpm + Vercel. 44 Monday MCP tools (+description-doc), 14 skills, 9 rules, 25 hooks, per-project config, live People-board lookup.
